The '''Herd''' was a small band of [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] founded and led by [[Kikow]] in the years following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], the Herd was based on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] organization, the [[Kalmec]]. Consisting of a half-dozen Ithorian spacers, they trafficked illegal weaponry through the space lanes.
